objects.description: [TeamPCP](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1056) has cloned GitHub commit metadata including the author name, email, committer, and timestamps to use for impostor commits.(Citation: Aqua Security Blog Trivy Compromise APR 2026) [TeamPCP](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1056) has also used legitimate file names such as msbuild.exe and ringtone.wav to mask malicious payloads.(Citation: Aikido TeamPCP Telnyx MAR 2026)(Citation: Palo Alto TeamPCP MAR 2026)
